0.name: Poison Fog
0.desc: Generates a fog of poison in front,  causing the opponent to become poisoned.

5.name: Wind Cutter
5.desc: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

6.name: Hydro Jet
6.desc: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

7.name: Air Cannon
7.desc: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

9.name: Multicutter
9.desc: The user fires three high-speed blades of wind in quick succession that fly straight at enemies.

10.name: Ignis Blast
10.desc: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

11.name: Ice Missile
11.desc: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

12.name: Sand Blast
12.desc: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

13.name: Dragon Cannon
13.desc: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

14.name: Spark Blast
14.desc: The user releases a lightning ball that expands outward in a forward, circular pattern.

15.name: Chicken Rush
15.desc: Chikipi's special skill. Flies at enemies in its sights, attacking them with its sharp beak.

16.name: Shockwave
16.desc: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

17.name: Power Shot
17.desc: Charges energy into a focused blast.

18.name: Poison Blast
18.desc: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

19.name: Roly Poly
19.desc:
Lamball's special skill. Curls into a ball, rolling after any enemies in its way.
Becomes dizzy and unable to move after the attack ends.

21.name: Aqua Gun
21.desc: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

22.name: Seed Machine Gun
22.desc: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

23.name: Punch Flurry
23.desc:
Cattiva's special skill. Pursues enemies, repeatedly punching them
with both its fists.

24.name: Electric Ball
24.desc: Fires an electric ball that slowly pursues an enemy.

25.name: Spirit Fire
25.desc:
Shoots fireballs towards an enemy. The fireballs explode after a short distance,
generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

26.name: Fluffy Tackle
26.desc: Melpaca's exclusive skill. Charges forward while clad in an aura of sublime adorableness.

27.name: Dark Ball
27.desc: Unleashes a sphere of darkness  that slowly tracks down the enemy.

28.name: Reckless Charge
28.desc: Rushoar's special skill. Takes aim at a foe and rushes at them with a mad charge.

29.name: Stone Blast
29.desc: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

30.name: Fierce Fang
30.desc: Direhowl's special skill. Swiftly leaps at an enemy and bites into them.

31.name: Seed Mine
31.desc: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

32.name: Gale Claw
32.desc:
Galeclaw's exclusive skill. Soars through the air
with its talons outstretched forward.

33.name: Stone Cannon
33.desc: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

34.name: Shadow Burst
34.desc: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

35.name: Antler Uppercut
35.desc:
Eikthyrdeer's exclusive skill. Charges at foes and uses antlers to launch them into the air.
If used while riding, the direction of the charge can be controlled.

36.name: Dragon Burst
36.desc: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

37.name: Plasma Tornado
37.desc: Creates two balls of electric energy that fire numerous bolts of lightning at enemies.

38.name: Blazing Horn
38.desc: Arsox's exclusive skill. Takes aim and rushes at an enemy with a mad dash.

39.name: Phantom Peck
39.desc:
Cawgnito's exclusive skill. Teleports next to an enemy
before attacking with its beak.

40.name: Icicle Cutter
40.desc: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

41.name: Cat Press
41.desc:
Grintale's exclusive skill. Grins menacingly before leaping into the air
and smashing foes with its body.

44.name: Flare Arrow
44.desc: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

45.name: Botanical Smash
45.desc:
Dinossom's exclusive skill. Uses large tail to smash the ground in front of it,
damaging enemies over a wide area.

46.name: Jumping Claw
46.desc:
Loupmoon's exclusive skill. Leaps forward and attacks twice with vicious claws
imbued with dark energy.

47.name: Shell Spin
47.desc:
Digtoise's exclusive skill. Moves while spinning its whole body at high speeds.
Drills through enemies, dealing continuous damage.

48.name: Freezing Charge
48.desc: Reindrix's exclusive skill. Charges at an enemy with antlers adorned in ice.

49.name: Giga Horn
49.desc: Warsect 's exclusive skill. Skewers enemies with its four sturdy horns.

50.name: Iceberg
50.desc: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

51.name: Bubble Blast
51.desc: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

52.name: Lock-on Laser
52.desc: Takes aim at an enemy before firing a super high speed laser.

53.name: Focus Shot
53.desc:
Robinquill's exclusive skill. Takes aim while drawing its bow
before loosing a powerful shot at an enemy.

54.name: Spinning Lance
54.desc: Elizabee's exclusive skill. Channels power into its staff, and unleashes it in a whirl.

55.name: Muscle Slam
55.desc:
Broncherry's exclusive skill. Turns sideways before tackling enemies in front of it,
sending them flying into the air.

56.name: Spinning Roundhouse
56.desc: Anubis's special skill. Performs a spin kick with its strong legs, cutting down enemies over a wide area.

57.name: Draconic Breath
57.desc: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

58.name: Ignis Breath
58.desc: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

59.name: Power Bomb
59.desc: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

60.name: Lightning Claw
60.desc: Grizzbolt's special skill. After leaping at an enemy and tearing at it twice with its electrically charged claws, it attacks the ground, sending an electric shock throughout the area.

61.name: Mystic Whirlwind
61.desc:
Elphidran's exclusive skill. Generates twin whirlwinds imbued with a mysterious power
that pursues enemies.

62.name: Ground Pound
62.desc:
Gorirat's exclusive skill. Pounds the ground twice before leaping into the air
and unleashing a powerful punch.

63.name: Cloud Tempest
63.desc:
Fenglope's exclusive skill. Charges forward while manipulating the atmosphere
to create a pressurized wind tunnel around itself.

64.name: Daring Flames
64.desc: Kitsun's exclusive skill. Charges forward with great speed while clad in intense blue flames.

65.name: Tornado Attack
65.desc: Nitewing's exclusive skill. Generates a tornado before soaring towards its target.

66.name: Emperor Slide
66.desc:
Penking's exclusive skill. Lies on its belly while generating frozen air all around it
before sliding at enemies at high speed.

67.name: Lightning Streak
67.desc: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

68.name: Spirit Flame
68.desc: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

69.name: Ignis Slam
69.desc:
Pyrin's exclusive skill. Charges forward while clad in a veil of flames.
Flames continue to burn in its wake.

70.name: Hellfire Claw
70.desc:
Incineram's exclusive skill. Draws near enemies using its left claw to slash them into the air
before cutting them down with its right claw.

71.name: Dark Charge
71.desc:
Pyrin Noct's exclusive skill. Charges forward while clad in a veil of dark flames.
Flames continue to burn in its trajectory.

73.name: Sand Tornado
73.desc: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

74.name: Grass Tornado
74.desc: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

75.name: Flare Storm
75.desc: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

76.name: Acid Rain
76.desc: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

77.name: Crushing Punch
77.desc: Mossanda's exclusive skill. Winds up its fist before striking an enemy with a devastating punch.

78.name: Forceful Charge
78.desc:
Anubis's special skill. Pursues its foe with a high speed dash
while releasing energy and unleashes a powerful punch.

79.name: Tri-Lightning
79.desc: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

80.name: Cryst Breath
80.desc: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

81.name: Iaigiri
81.desc:
Bushi's exclusive skill. After Holding the sword, he appears in front of the enemy
in an instant and unleashes a Ultra-fast sword draw attack.

82.name: Spine Vine
82.desc: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

84.name: Nightmare Ball
84.desc: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

85.name: Aqua Burst
85.desc: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

87.name: Earth Impact
87.desc:
Mammorest's exclusive skill. Uses massive body to shake the earth,
dealing damage over a wide area.

89.name: Kingly Slam
89.desc:
Kingpaca's exclusive skill. Leaps high into the air before
smashing into an enemy with its massive body.

91.name: Volcanic Burst
91.desc:
Reptyro's exclusive skill. Raises its front legs before slamming them into the ground,
causing volcanic eruptions under its enemies.
It simultaneously bombards them with volcanic bombs from above.

92.name: Kerauno
92.desc:
Orserk's exclusive skill. Summons a blade of lightning while leaping into the air
before throwing it at an enemy.

93.name: Frost Burst
93.desc:
Ice Reptyro's exclusive skill. Raises its front legs and slams them into the ground
causing frozen blasts under its enemies.
It simultaneously pounds them with snow balls from above.

95.name: Crystal Wing
95.desc:
Frostallion's exclusive skill. Dashes forward while creating frigid air around its wings,
using them to slash enemies.

96.name: Spear Thrust
96.desc:
Paladius's exclusive skill. Clads itself in holy power before charging forward with its spear.
The shield in its other hand protects from attacks during the charge.

98.name: Blizzard Spike
98.desc: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

99.name: Ground Smash
99.desc:
Anubis's special skill. Leaps high into the air before diving to the ground with a punch.
The force of the impact deals damage over a wide area.

100.name: Phoenix Flare
100.desc: Faleris's special skill. Covers its body in a tornado of flames before charging forward.

101.name: Ignis Rage
101.desc: Energizes the surrounding ground, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

102.name: Lightning Strike
102.desc: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

103.name: Divine Disaster
103.desc:
Shadowbeak's exclusive skill. Charges forward while generating orbs of light that automatically capture enemies.
The orbs automatically capture enemies, before releasing a barrage of lasers.

104.name: Beam Comet
104.desc:
Jetragon's exclusive skill. Flies at enemies on illuminated wings while firing innumerable beams.
The beams explode on impact.

105.name: Hydro Laser
105.desc: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

106.name: Dark Laser
106.desc: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

107.name: Pal Blast
107.desc: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

108.name: Rock Lance
108.desc: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

109.name: Dragon Meteor
109.desc: Calls down numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

110.name: Lightning Bolt
110.desc: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

111.name: Fire Ball
111.desc: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

112.name: Solar Blast
112.desc: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

113.name: Implode
113.desc: Risks its life to cause a violent explosion. Becomes incapacitated afterwards.

114.name: Bee Quiet
114.desc: Risks its life to cause a violent explosion, but receives the honor of falling in battle.

115.name: Twin Spears
115.desc:
Necromus' exclusive skill. Clads its twin spears with vicious whirlwinds and charges forward,
thrusting them one after the other.

116.name: Blast Punch
116.desc: Mossanda Lux's exclusive skill. Winds up its fist before pummeling an enemy with a flurry of electrically charged punches.

117.name: Dark Whisp
117.desc: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

118.name: Megaton Implode
118.desc: Risks life to cause a massive explosion. Those who perish for their duty become glistening stars in the night sky.

ACTION_SKILL_BubbleShower.name: Poison Shower
ACTION_SKILL_BubbleShower.desc: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

ACTION_SKILL_WindBurst.name: Wind Burst
ACTION_SKILL_WindBurst.desc: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

ACTION_SKILL_MudShot.name: Bog Blast
ACTION_SKILL_MudShot.desc: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_Tremor.name: Rockburst
ACTION_SKILL_Tremor.desc: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

ACTION_SKILL_SandTwister.name: Sand Twister
ACTION_SKILL_SandTwister.desc: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

ACTION_SKILL_RockBeat.name: Rocky Impact
ACTION_SKILL_RockBeat.desc: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

ACTION_SKILL_HolyBlast.name: Holy Burst
ACTION_SKILL_HolyBlast.desc: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

ACTION_SKILL_DiversionLaser.name: Torrential Blast
ACTION_SKILL_DiversionLaser.desc: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

ACTION_SKILL_HydroSlicer.name: Hydro Slicer
ACTION_SKILL_HydroSlicer.desc: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

ACTION_SKILL_SeaGush.name: Geyser Gush
ACTION_SKILL_SeaGush.desc: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_IceWall.name: Freeze Wall
ACTION_SKILL_IceWall.desc: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

ACTION_SKILL_DiamondFall.name: Diamond Rain
ACTION_SKILL_DiamondFall.desc: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

ACTION_SKILL_IceAge.name: Absolute Frost
ACTION_SKILL_IceAge.desc: Throws icicles in a wide area from under the enemy's feet.

ACTION_SKILL_ThunderSpear.name: Thunder Spear
ACTION_SKILL_ThunderSpear.desc: Fires a high-speed lightning spear straight ahead towards the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_LineGeyser.name: Splash
ACTION_SKILL_LineGeyser.desc: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

ACTION_SKILL_TriSpark.name: TriSpark
ACTION_SKILL_TriSpark.desc: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_ThunderStorm.name: Thunderstorm
ACTION_SKILL_ThunderStorm.desc: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_DragonBreath.name: Dragon Breath
ACTION_SKILL_DragonBreath.desc: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

ACTION_SKILL_FrostBreath.name: Crystal Breath
ACTION_SKILL_FrostBreath.desc: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

ACTION_SKILL_ChargeCanon.name: Charge Cannon
ACTION_SKILL_ChargeCanon.desc: Fires an energy orb infused with draconic power at the enemy. The orb causes a wide-area explosion upon impact.

ACTION_SKILL_FlameWall.name: Flame Wall
ACTION_SKILL_FlameWall.desc: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

ACTION_SKILL_Eruption.name: Volcanic Rain
ACTION_SKILL_Eruption.desc: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

ACTION_SKILL_Commet.name: Comet Strike
ACTION_SKILL_Commet.desc: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

ACTION_SKILL_BeamSlicer.name: Beam Slicer
ACTION_SKILL_BeamSlicer.desc: Mows down the area in front with a beam imbued with dragon power. The area struck by the beam will also explode after a short delay.

ACTION_SKILL_AirBlade.name: Air Blade
ACTION_SKILL_AirBlade.desc: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

ACTION_SKILL_DarkPulse.name: Umbral Surge
ACTION_SKILL_DarkPulse.desc: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

ACTION_SKILL_DarkCanon.name: Dark Cannon
ACTION_SKILL_DarkCanon.desc: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_DarkArrow.name: Dark Arrow
ACTION_SKILL_DarkArrow.desc: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_Unique_DarkMutant_DarkTackl.name: Apocalypse
ACTION_SKILL_Unique_DarkMutant_DarkTackl.desc: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_IcicleLine.name: Icicle Line
ACTION_SKILL_IcicleLine.desc: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

ACTION_SKILL_FlameFunnel.name: Flame Funnel
ACTION_SKILL_FlameFunnel.desc: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_IciclePierce.name: Icicle Bullet
ACTION_SKILL_IciclePierce.desc: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

ACTION_SKILL_ThunderFunnel.name: Plasma Funnel
ACTION_SKILL_ThunderFunnel.desc: Creates two balls of electric energy that fire numerous lightning orbs at enemies.

ACTION_SKILL_RipTide.name: Aqua Surge
ACTION_SKILL_RipTide.desc: Generates waves that surge around the enemy from all sides. They converge and explode at the center, erupting into a column of water.

ACTION_SKILL_RootLance.name: Circle Vine
ACTION_SKILL_RootLance.desc: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

ACTION_SKILL_ThunderRain.name: Thunder Rain
ACTION_SKILL_ThunderRain.desc: Calls lightning that strikes an enemy after a set amount of time has passed.

ACTION_SKILL_WallSplash.name: Curtain Splash
ACTION_SKILL_WallSplash.desc: Continously creates walls made from water columns at the enemy's location.

ACTION_SKILL_GravityShot.name: Dark Shot
ACTION_SKILL_GravityShot.desc: Fires a dark energy projectile that accelerates over time.

ACTION_SKILL_RangeThunder.name: All Range Thunder
ACTION_SKILL_RangeThunder.desc: Generates lightning strikes that travel in a straight line in all directions.

ACTION_SKILL_ReflectiveShuriken.name: Reflect Leaf
ACTION_SKILL_ReflectiveShuriken.desc: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

ACTION_SKILL_CrossWind.name: Crosswind
ACTION_SKILL_CrossWind.desc: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

ACTION_SKILL_BlastCanon.name: Blast Cannon
ACTION_SKILL_BlastCanon.desc: Fires an energy bullet imbued with dragon power at the enemy's location. Upon impact, the bullet shatters and creates a frontal long-range explosion.
